Overview

Chuuni (Delusion) is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. She can only be obtained by evolving Chuuni

Evolving

Chuuni (Delusion) can be evolved from Chuuni with the following materials:

x1 Sichel des Trugs

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Pact Of Frailty

Targeted enemies by Chuuni (Delusion) takes 50% increased Magic damage. This effect can be stack up to 3 times.

Pact Of Frailty can only affect one enemy per each Chuuni (Delusion) at a time.

Passive Ability: Pact Of Revelation

Targeted enemies by Chuuni (Delusion) takes damage equal to 7% of Chuuni (Delusion) damage each 0.5 seconds.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Unique Trait in Chuuni (Delusion) makes the enemy affected by Pact Of Frailty take 150% increased Magic damage instead of the 50% they would normally take with just 1 placement of Chuuni (Delusion).
  • Pact Of Frailty can only stack up to 300% increased Magic damage
  • Pact Of Frailty depends on Chuuni (Delusion) target system, so if she was set strongest while reached to full AOE upgrade, her passive only target highest HP enemy within her range.
